text_block_list.name: Girl with False Eyelashes
text_block_list.text: Hey, Boss. Next week's shift schedule, like, doesn't look right.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: Huh? It should be fine. I checked it over several times.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: Uh, there's definitely something wrong. Look, Ines has, like, a billion shifts now.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: …Hm? No, there's nothing out of the ordinary here. She's working irregular shifts this month.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today's the first day of summer camp! I'm on the bus to the academy campsite with Ines Fujin.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yaaawn… Morning… Man, it's so bright out.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But! All that sleep's charged me right up! Okay, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, this? Side gig stuff. I can't go working shifts while I'm at camp, right?
choice_data_list: I didn't know you did side gigs…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I just started. Anything to up my earnings!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It's not that bad, you know? I can do this stuff whenever I have some spare time. You should help me out when you're free!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okay, enough personal chit-chat. Let's talk training!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Our new goal is to figure out how to run with max efficiency, right? I'm in for a tough ride unless we do something about my constant collapsing.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm assuming you've thought about it a bunch. Y'know, about how I can transform into a super energy saver!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! Don't go soft on me, okay? Cheers to a successful summer camp!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, summer camp kicks off.
